title: Canonical ready words
statement: Given $k$ and a header bit string $h$, define a word for each index $j<k$: it is $h$ when $j=0$, the canonical count code of $h$ when $j=1$, the canonical offset code of $h$ when $j=2$, and the empty string for every other index.
hypotheses_covered: The header is a bit string
The index ranges over the $k$ positions
caveat: The definition of the canonical count code is not included.
